summary: Stalwart Mail Server is an all-in-one messaging platform that handles SMTP, IMAP4, and JMAP protocols. It provides a complete solution for self-hosting electronic mail infrastructure with a focus on modern protocol support.
goodFor: It is well-suited for system administrators looking to deploy a contemporary, containerised email stack with support for modern protocols like JMAP.
watchOut: Self-hosting email carries a high operational burden regarding deliverability, DNS configuration, and security, compounded by the copyleft requirements of the AGPL-3.0 licence.
deployNotes: As a containerised Rust application, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for mail data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination properly.
